title: Add loop backend name to TUI header
description: Render a persistent header bar in the RocketLoopApp showing the project name and backend name. Use cyan for the Rocket Loop label and dim for the rest.
acceptanceCriteria: TUI header shows 'Rocket Loop | Project: <cwd basename> | Backend: <backend.name>'
'Rocket Loop' label is shown in cyan
Project name and backend name are dimmed
Header appears at the top of the TUI at all times

steps.details: At the top of the RocketLoopApp render: <Box><Text color='cyan' bold>Rocket Loop</Text><Text dimColor> | Project: {path.basename(process.cwd())} | Backend: {backend.name}</Text></Box>

steps.description: Verify header appears in all states
steps.details: Confirm the header is rendered in all states (selecting, running, complete, blocked, decide) — it should always be visible.
